To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
TTCP-c has a better cementing properties than TTCP-a and TTCP-b.
the setting time of the cement-c (with the TTCP-c) was the shortest, compared to the cement-a (the conventional TTCP-a) and cement-b (the TTCP-b).
the TTCP purity is not the only factor for the fast setting time of the cement, but the HA phase also plays an important role in the cement setting.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of TTCP powder for calcium phosphate bone cement.
the preparation of TTCP and the effect on cementing properties of TTCP.
a new process to prepare TTCP for bone cement.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the TTCP-c powder is the most promising for a new hardener Na 3 PO 4 for the calcium phosphate cement.
the TTCP-c has the best cementing properties among the three TTCP samples.
the TTCP-c is a better starting material for the preparation of calcium phosphate cement than the TTCP-b.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the TTCP-c is a good candidate for a calcium phosphate bone cement.
the wet process is a promising method to prepare high purity TTCP powder and the TTCP-c powder can be used as a seed material for the synthesis of HA in calcium phosphate cement.
the newly proposed methods (TTP-b and c) are more suitable for the preparation of TTCP for bone cement than the conventional dry milling method.
The main takeaway from our work is that
a wet process for the preparation can be integrated to the conventional method to obtain the TTCP with high purity.
TTCP-c is a promising material for calcium phosphate bone cement.
TTCP-c powder is more suitable for the preparation of calcium phosphate cements with a short setting time.
